svg.aria-label: A shrink in six steps. Check reads only. Clean removes only what you chose inside the distribution. Stop stops its containers with their own timeouts and runs your pre-stop scripts. Compact is WSL's own wsl --manage --compact. Verify reads the disk again and compares it with before. Start again brings the distribution back, writable, with the containers that ran.
